development_failures: Self-review before the first test run found that the first controls projection was not idempotent: normalizing a frozen state again would have dropped the placement exclusions. It was replaced by one normalized form that accepts its own output, and verification now compares the controls as one serialized value so that a control that should have been removed cannot pass.
A bash heredoc for that fix failed on quoting and applied nothing; the fix was applied from a script file.
limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
Location keys, interest IDs and employer or position IDs are checked for shape; their existence is left to Meta.
Meta applies account controls asynchronously; verification compares the stored controls, not their application to each campaign (campaigns_with_error is shown by the read).
Adding publishers to block lists and applying lists are not part of this family.
No GitHub CLI here and CAMCP is private: CI for the pushed commits was not read from this checkout.
No local Docker; container build/smoke evidence comes from GitHub Actions on the pushed commit.
